title: Core editor and ribbon workspace
summary: A consolidated release of the user-verified editor: crisp vector display, live editing, grouped ribbons, object controls and compact properties.

Added: Home, Tool Settings, Export and Advanced Settings ribbons with persistent Favorites and tool ordering.
Objects pane with descriptive labels, drag stacking, visibility and locking.
Raster Preview, Fit to Screen, automatic transparent canvas growth and trimming, and rotate handles.
Independent Step outlines, underline and strikethrough, shared format painting and live mixed-selection text formatting.
Improved: Inline Text properties for shapes, callouts and Steps with Back to Object; color controls update live and saved colors support Update/Remove.
Consistent grouped Quick Styles, custom-style popup, live creation previews and remembered formatting.
Stable corner handles and continuous rounding, first-object alignment with canvas expansion, Crop panning and zooming, and compact footer controls.
Property instructions are in circled-question-mark header tooltips; Selection actions have distinct icons.
Verified: All64 accumulated manual checks passed by the user across the recorded candidate builds; exact tested-build attribution is preserved.
364 automated Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy; synthetic egui interaction and render fixtures.
Exact optimized export/viewport/previous-fixture equality, portable projects, Undo and existing Library persistence checks.

limitations: Clipboard paste into the current canvas, Simplify, persistent groups and additional selection masks remain unfinished.
Text outlines, per-object shadows, advanced Line/Arrow configuration and additional typography options are still planned or in development.
Two bundled font families and basic left-to-right text layout; system fonts and mixed styling within one text box are not yet available.
This unsigned Windows alpha retains the existing Library capacity and capture qualification limitations.
